picture.area: area is {topLeft: {x, y}, bottomRight: {x, y}} in grid units, the top left above and left of the bottom right
picture.cardsAndArea: Give cards or area, not both
picture.depth: depth is 1, 2, or 0 for every line ({given})
picture.ghost: {path} is a card ghost: a picture is drawn of the card it leads to, {card} (use)
picture.hint: Drawn at {percent}% of the screen's size: words may be hard to read. {ways}
picture.hint.narrow: Narrow it with cards or area, or raise maxSize (up to 3000)
picture.how.enumValue: draw its enum ({card}), or read the value with card_read
picture.how.field: draw its card ({card}), or read the field with card_read
picture.how.row: draw its card ({card}), or read the row with as: markdown
picture.key.depth: depth is taken by a connections map alone (a card that is not a flow, goal or container); {path} is drawn as a {map}
picture.key.kinds: kinds is not taken by a flow's node diagram (the flow draws its own lines); {path} is drawn as a {map}
picture.key.range: {keys} are taken by a section map and a content map alone; {path} is drawn as a {map}
picture.margin: margin is from 0 to 100 grid units ({given})
picture.noApp: no SpecBoard app is connected to draw it
picture.notCard: as: picture draws one card or one section; {path} is {what}: {how}
picture.notDrawn: No picture: {why}. Pictures are drawn by the SpecBoard app; as: diagram reads the same map as text (mermaid)
picture.target.many: as: picture draws one card at a time ({count} targets given)
picture.unreadable: the app's answer cannot be read ({head})
